speaker: davy_gannet
text: Hold that corner, Master Will, and do not argue with the knot. The wind has the other one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the corner. Knot it. Heminges bespoke you for Wednesday's flood.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Wednesday's flood, six oars, and myself at the stern. If the Queen leaves any water in the river.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: She is to go today. That was Saturday's word.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Saturday's word is wet through. She will not go to Richmond at all. The river freezes by Friday. The Spaniard has heard of the weather and is coming. I had it of a man at the bridge, and he had it of a better one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Three stories, Davy. You are wrong by a third, and I do not yet know which third.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: Then keep the third and give me the canvas. Pull. The gust comes up under the bridge like a bellows.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six oars. Yourself. Wednesday, on the flood. The paper goes in first and driest, under this, or Heminges will have both our heads.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: The paper shall be drier than you are now. Your cloak is soaked on the weather side already. Sit trim on Wednesday. Today you walk.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Up Fish Street Hill, and into it. If the flood is late, you send.

speaker: davy_gannet
text: I do not send. I am at the stair, or I am not your man. Wednesday, Master Will. God keep you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: And you. Leave the canvas lashed. I will not pay twice to have it done again in the morning.
